description: MeshConfig defines the top level CustomResource for holding the dynamic mesh configuration. This configuration can be updated by a user at runtime to change the global mesh settings.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: Spec defines the desired configuration for NGINX Service Mesh.

clientMaxBodySize.description: ClientMaxBodySize is NGINX client max body size.

meshConfigClassName.description: MeshConfigClassName used for this MeshConfig. This is the name of a MeshConfigClass resource.

mtls.description: Mtls is the configuration for mutual TLS.

caKeyType.description: CaKeyType is the key type used for the SPIRE Server CA.

caTTL.description: CaTTL is the CA/signing key TTL in hours(h). Min value 24h. Max value 999999h.

svidTTL.description: SvidTTL is the TTL of certificates issued to workloads in hours(h) or minutes(m). Max value is 999999.

nginxErrorLogLevel.description: NGINXErrorLogLevel is the NGINX error log level.

nginxLBMethod.description: NGINXLBMethod is the NGINX load balancing method.

nginxLogFormat.description: NGINXLogFormat is the NGINX log format.

prometheusAddress.description: PrometheusAddress is the address of a Prometheus server deployed in your Kubernetes cluster.

telemetry.description: Telemetry is the configuration for telemetry.

exporters.description: Exporters is the exporters configuration for telemetry.

otlp.description: Otlp is the configuration for an OTLP gRPC exporter.

host.description: Host of the OpenTelemetry gRPC exporter to connect to.

port.description: Port of the OpenTelemetry gRPC exporter to connect to.

samplerRatio.description: SamplerRatio is the percentage of traces that are processed and exported to the telemetry backend.

status.description: Status defines the configuration status for NGINX Service Mesh.

transparent.description: Transparent status is updated once the mesh controller has successfully turned all sidecar proxies transparent.
